verdict.rationale: GrowthBook has a dedicated first-party OpenFeature docs page. It states that switching to or from GrowthBook only requires changing the provider bootstrap, not any flag call, which directly covers the vendor-neutral flag code this story asks for. The evidence is a single line, though, and gives no detail on which languages have providers or how mature they are. missing for 10: list of supported OpenFeature provider languages/runtimes, provider feature-parity details (e.g. experiments/tracking hooks), independent or hands-on corroboration.
